thread:
pagerduty-bot: URGENT: High error rate and packet loss observed from region-eu-west -> backbone provider Glide (PD alert P12345). Triggered by: backend-transport-loss. Escalation: neteng on-call. :rotating_light:

maria_gomez: I'm seeing customer 42 errors spike and internal p99 latency up ~300ms. Cloud provider metrics show increased retransmits on egress to AS64555. Putting initial postmortem channel.

lee_walton: Confirmed — BGP peers with Glide in eu-west are flapping routes. I'm seeing AS path changes and intermittent withdraws for our /24s. Traceroutes show a hop with 40-60% loss.

santhosh_r: tagging @neteng-bot and @arjun_n (neteng oncall). Any config changes on our side?

arjun_n: oncall here. Pulling BGP logs and zabbix alarms. Running quick bgp summary from sfo-eu-bgp-proxy: ```
# show ip bgp summary | i Glide
Neighbor        AS       MsgRcv  MsgSnt  Up/Down  State/PfxRcd
10.10.20.2      64555    123456  123401  00:12:03  5000
```

arjun_n: BGP sessions are up but there are a lot of prefix churn events. Looks like Glide is oscillating advertisement for some transit prefixes.

maria_gomez: Customer impact: some customers in EU are seeing 502s and degraded response times for embeddings and hosted endpoints. I've opened a ticket with Priority: High.

lee_walton: Quick mitigation suggestion: shift routing for eu-west egress to our secondary transit provider (AS64444) via policy for affected prefixes and rate-limit BGP updates from Glide. That should reduce packetloss impact while neteng engages with Glide.

santhosh_r: +1. We have DR route policy available. Can do a targeted reroute for user-facing subnets: 34.56.78.0/24, 34.56.79.0/24.

arjun_n: Preparing canary reroute now. Command (on edge-router-set): ```
set policy route-map REROUTE-GLIDE permit 10
match ip address prefix-list AFFECTED-EU
set as-path prepend 64555 64555
exit
apply policy out to peer AS64444
```

arjun_n: Applying to 2 eu-west edge peers — rolling deploy. Expect propagation in ~30s.

neteng-bot: ACTION: route-policy apply started by arjun_n on 3 edge-routers. Job ID: 8492.

lee_walton: monitoring flows. If p99 latency drops and errors fall, we'll keep route in place for 30 minutes and then attempt negotiated downgrade.

maria_gomez: Noting customer comms: posting to status page draft — "We are investigating degraded connectivity to eu-west for some users due to an upstream provider routing instability. We have applied mitigations and are monitoring." Will push to status once we have confirmation.

sophie_k: FYI — CDN metrics show origin fetch retries reduced by half after reroute. Good signal.

arjun_n: Glide support said they're seeing a DDoS near their POP which is causing internal route dampening. They've temporarily withdrawn a handful of prefixes. They're escalating and will send updates in 15m.

lee_walton: Continuing to see intermittent packet loss on the Glider path but traffic is moving via AS64444 now. Error rate dropped from 8% -> 1.2% for affected endpoints.

maria_gomez: I pushed the status page update. Added remediation note and ETA for next update 15m.

neteng-bot: NOTE: job 8492 completed successfully on 3 routers.

arjun_n: Handoff — I need to sign out in 25m. @santhosh_r can you take on-call after me? I'll document what I changed and attach BGP logs to the incident ticket.

santhosh_r: I can take handoff at +30. Please include the exact route-policy and job ID. Also leaving a note: do not withdraw reroute until Glide confirms stable advertisements for 1 hour.

maria_gomez: Impact summary for ops: ~12% of EU traffic briefly affected, top customers impacted: cust-42, cust-99. No data plane breach. Mitigation: traffic rerouted to secondary provider. Next steps: wait for upstream stabilization, then rollback and test.

lee_walton: Follow-up checks: run periodic traceroutes to Glide and AS64444, verify BGP Adj-RIB and AS path counts, and confirm CDN origin success rate.

arjun_n: Adding logs to ticket: bgp_peer_changes.log, traceroute_snapshots.tar.gz, and netdiag outputs.

maria_gomez: We'll schedule a post-incident review if Glide doesn't provide RCA in 48h. For now I'll keep status updates at +15m and +60m.

neteng-bot: INCIDENT: resolution-state = mitigated (traffic rerouted). Next update scheduled by maria_gomez in 15m. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
